scripts.text:
[Airship Crew]
If we've landed at
your destination and
you'd like to leave the
Airship, please use the
stairs up ahead. Thank
you for your patronage.
scripts.translation:
[飛空艇船員]
如果飛空艇已抵達您的目的地，請從前方的樓梯下船。
感謝您的惠顧。

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Wow, mom!
L-look at this!
We're flying! W-we're...
We're in the freakin' sky!
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
哇，媽媽！
快...快看！
我們在飛！我...我們...
我們真的飛到天上啦！

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Makumalagu!
Saampa joojimbo
kaku na jedi Solo.
Bwahahahahahahaah!
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
Makumalagu!
Saampa joojimbo
kaku na jedi Solo.
Bwahahahahahahaah!

scripts.text:
[Lady]
Shush...
Honey, behave~
Don't act so excited
when we're out in a
public place like this!
scripts.translation:
[女士]
噓...
寶貝，乖一點~
在這種公共場合，別這麼大驚小怪！

scripts.text:
[Lady]
Chooktu!
Sacraup matii!
Shaka gurftalfi
huntiki manjoo!
scripts.translation:
[女士]
Chooktu!
Sacraup matii!
Shaka gurftalfi
huntiki manjoo!

scripts.text:
[Chrmlim]
Hey there~
From that look on
your face, I see that
you can understand
me. ^333333*Whew...!*^000000
scripts.translation:
[查姆林]
你好~
看你的表情，我就知道你能聽懂我說話。
^333333*呼...！*^000000

scripts.text:
[Chrmlim]
I've been helping the
Airship enterprise by
having the Airship Crewmen
train in Umbala to overcome
any acrophobia they might have through bungee jumping. Neat, eh?
scripts.translation:
[查姆林]
我一直在幫飛空艇公司訓練船員，讓他們到汶巴拉練習高空彈跳，克服恐高症。
很棒吧？

scripts.text:
[Chrmlim]
But...
Some of them couldn't
overcome their fear of
heights. And a few even
ended up, um, ^333333in Niflheim^000000.
scripts.translation:
[查姆林]
但是...
有些人還是克服不了恐高症。
甚至有幾個人最後去了...嗯，^333333尼弗海姆^000000。

scripts.text:
[Chrmlim]
Bajoo ga
nukta Airship.
scripts.translation:
[查姆林]
Bajoo ga
nukta Airship.

scripts.text:
[Chrmlim]
Shabala moow bajama
Airship kulaha googoona 
salu. Dama, kookoo na nu
yukuta. Um, fashuku na ret!
scripts.translation:
[查姆林]
Shabala moow bajama
Airship kulaha googoona 
salu. Dama, kookoo na nu
yukuta. Um, fashuku na ret!

scripts.text:
[Airship Staff]
Welcome
to the Airship.
How may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[飛空艇工作人員]
歡迎乘坐飛空艇。
您需要什麼服務呢？

scripts.text: Do you have a passenger named Thierry?
scripts.translation: 有位叫蒂埃裡的乘客嗎？

scripts.text:
[Airship Staff]
I am sorry, but I do not think that we have a passenger by that name.
scripts.translation:
[飛空艇工作人員]
很抱歉，我想我們這裡沒有叫這個名字的乘客。

scripts.text:
[Airship Staff]
Welcome
to the Airship.
How may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[飛空艇工作人員]
歡迎乘坐飛空艇。
您需要什麼服務呢？

scripts.text: Using the Airship
scripts.translation: 乘坐須知

scripts.text: Captain's Cabin
scripts.translation: 船長室

scripts.text: Facilities
scripts.translation: 設施

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Airship Staff]
When you see a broadcast
announcing that we have
arrived at your destination,
please use one of the exits
located at the north and
south ends of the Airship.
scripts.translation:
[飛空艇工作人員]
當廣播通知已抵達您的目的地時，請從飛空艇南北兩端的任一齣口下船。

scripts.text:
[Airship Staff]
If you happen to miss
your stop, don't worry.
The Airship is constantly
en route and you'll get
another chance to arrive
to your intended destination.
scripts.translation:
[飛空艇工作人員]
如果不小心坐過站了，也不用擔心。
飛空艇會持續迴圈航行，您還有機會抵達目的地。

scripts.text:
[Airship Staff]
The Captain's Cabin
is located at the front
of the Airship. There, you
can meet the captain and
the pilot of the Airship.
scripts.translation:
[飛空艇工作人員]
船長室位於飛空艇前部。
您可以在那裡見到船長和飛行員。

scripts.text:
[Airship Staff]
The Airship provides
various Mini Games for
the entertainment of all
our passengers. We invite
you to try your luck and skills
in the Airship's Mini Games~
scripts.translation:
[飛空艇工作人員]
飛空艇為各位乘客準備了各種小遊戲。
歡迎來試試運氣、一展身手~

scripts.text:
[Airship Staff]
Well, I hope you
your flight aboard
our Airships. Thank
you and have a good day.
scripts.translation:
[飛空艇工作人員]
希望您在飛空艇上度過一段愉快的旅程。
謝謝，祝您今天愉快。

scripts.text:
[Zerta]
Oh, hello adventurer.
I am currently on a
sacred journey, offering
prayer for the sake of the
Midgard continent.
scripts.translation:
[澤塔]
哦，你好，冒險者。
我正在進行一趟神聖的旅程，為米德加爾特大陸祈禱。

scripts.text:
[Maelin]
Um, this Airship is
to Lutie, isn't it? I've
waiting so long,
but I haven't heard any
broadcast about Lutie.
scripts.translation:
[梅琳]
嗯，這艘飛空艇是開往薑餅城的吧？
我等了好久，卻一直沒聽到要到薑餅城的廣播。

scripts.text:
[Aanos]
Oh wooow~
The sky looks
so different and
pretty from up there!
scripts.translation:
[阿諾斯]
哇哦~
從這裡看天空，感覺好不一樣，好漂亮啊！

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
I wish that I could go drink a cold fresh beer.
Drinking is the goal of my life! Drinking gives me energy!
I am nothing without drinks!
scripts.translation:
[飛行員]
真想去喝杯冰鎮鮮啤酒啊。
喝酒就是我的人生目標！喝酒讓我渾身是勁！
沒了酒，我可就什麼都不是了！

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
But! Driving under the influence is not good.
But! That makes me want to drink more and more!
scripts.translation:
[飛行員]
但是！酒後駕駛可不行。
但是！越是這樣，我就越想喝酒！

scripts.text: Do you know a passenger named Thierry?
scripts.translation: 你認識一位名叫蒂埃裡的乘客嗎？

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
This uniform is
really dapper, but
it's way too thick to
wear around the Airship.
scripts.translation:
[飛行員]
這身制服是挺帥，可在飛空艇上穿，實在太厚了。

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
...
......
No one ever really
comes into this room.
And the captain IS a reindeer. I could just strip to my boxers.
scripts.translation:
[飛行員]
...
......
反正也沒什麼人會進這間屋子。
而且船長還是隻馴鹿，我乾脆脫得只剩條內褲好了。

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
Wah!? Who is it!
scripts.translation:
[飛行員]
哇！？誰啊！

scripts.text: - ...He is not listening to you, at all. -
scripts.translation: - ...他完全沒在聽你說話。-

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
It's been sooo
long since I've
enjoyed a nice, cold
alcoholic brew. But the
job requires me to be as
clear headed as I can!
scripts.translation:
[飛行員]
我已經好久好久沒喝上一杯冰涼的好酒了。
可這份工作要求我時刻保持清醒！

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
Always drink responsibly!
Still, I can't remember the
last time I had a real vacation
or even a day off. Yeap, some
booze, some chips, some TV
and serious R&R is in order.
scripts.translation:
[飛行員]
喝酒一定要有節制！
話說回來，我都不記得上次休假是什麼時候了，哪怕只休一天也好啊。
沒錯，該喝點酒、吃點薯片、看看電視，好好放鬆一下了。

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
Man, the weather
is really nice today.
Bright, open skies make
for some good visibility
and safe, carefree flying.
scripts.translation:
[飛行員]
哎呀，今天天氣真好。
天空晴朗又開闊，能見度高，飛起來既安全又省心。

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
You know, our captain's a
respectable guy. Him and
his brother are actually well
known in the aircraft industry.
Who knew reindeer made
such good captains?
scripts.translation:
[飛行員]
你知道嗎，我們的船長可了不起。
他和他的兄弟在航空業都很有名。
誰能想到馴鹿能當這麼出色的船長呢？

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
Just between you
and me, I gotta tell
you, that Santa was onto
something, getting reindeers
and elves to work for him.
The man must be a genius!
scripts.translation:
[飛行員]
悄悄告訴你，聖誕老人找馴鹿和精靈為他幹活，還真有眼光。
他一定是個天才！

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
You know, this whole
piloting thing in the air,
it's rather new, you know?
Yeah, they got this Airship
operation in a hurry.
scripts.translation:
[飛行員]
你知道嗎，在天上駕駛飛空艇，其實還是挺新鮮的事。
對啊，他們急急忙忙就把飛空艇業務辦起來了。

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
Still, they were real
serious, really thought
ahead. I mean, they had us
training while the Airships
were still being invented.
Isn't that freakin' crazy?!
scripts.translation:
[飛行員]
不過，他們辦事很認真，也很有遠見。
飛空艇還在研發時，就已經開始訓練我們了。
是不是很瘋狂？！

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
Welcome to Fruitz's
Shop where you can
purchase Apples or grind
them to make Apple Juice.
scripts.translation:
[弗魯茨]
歡迎來到弗魯茨的小店，這裡可以買蘋果，也可以把蘋果榨成蘋果汁。

scripts.text: Buy Apples.
scripts.translation: 購買蘋果

scripts.text: Make Apple Juice.
scripts.translation: 製作蘋果汁

scripts.text: Why are you here?
scripts.translation: 你為什麼在這裡？

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
Please enter the amount
of Apples that you wish to
buy. Each Apple is 15 zeny
and you can buy a maximum
of 500 at a time. Please enter
 '0' to cancel your order.
scripts.translation:
[弗魯茨]
請輸入您想購買的蘋果數量。
每個蘋果15 Zeny，一次最多可購買500個。
輸入“0”可取消購買。

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
Thanks for stopping
by my shop. Farewell!
Come by anytime when
you feel like having an
Apple to snack on~
scripts.translation:
[弗魯茨]
感謝光臨我的小店，再見！
想吃蘋果時，隨時歡迎再來哦~

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
You've entered a number
higher than the maximum
value of 500. Please enter
the number of Apples you
wish to purchase again.
scripts.translation:
[弗魯茨]
您輸入的數字超過了最大值500。
請重新輸入您希望購買的蘋果數量。

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
A total of ^FF0000{0}^000000 Apples
will cost you ^FF0000{1}^000000 zeny.
Would you like to continue?
scripts.translation:
[弗魯茨]
購買^FF0000{0}^000000個蘋果，共需^FF0000{1}^000000 Zeny。
您要繼續購買嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
Thanks for stopping
by my shop. Farewell!
Come by anytime when
you feel like having an
Apple to snack on~
scripts.translation:
[弗魯茨]
感謝光臨我的小店，再見！
想吃蘋果時，隨時歡迎再來哦~

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
I'm sorry, but you don't
have enough money to
purchase that many Apples.
Please check your zeny or
purchase fewer Apples.
scripts.translation:
[弗魯茨]
很抱歉，您的Zeny不足，買不了這麼多蘋果。
請檢查您持有的Zeny，或減少購買數量。

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
Hmmm, I don't think
you've got enough room in
your inventory to carry this
many Apples. Why don't you free up some of your inventory space?
scripts.translation:
[弗魯茨]
嗯，您的背包空間不夠，裝不下這麼多蘋果。
先騰出一些空間吧？

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
Thanks for stopping by
my shop. I hope you enjoy
the flavor of these Apples~!
scripts.translation:
[弗魯茨]
感謝光臨我的小店。
希望您喜歡這些蘋果的味道~！

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
Okay, I'll need
^FF00003 Apples and 1 Empty Bottle^000000
to make 1 Apple Juice for you.
Would you like to proceed?
scripts.translation:
[弗魯茨]
好的，製作1瓶蘋果汁需要^FF00003個蘋果和1個空瓶^000000。
您要繼續嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
I'm sorry, but you don't
have enough materials to
create a bottle of Apple Juice.
Remember, I need 3 Apples
and 1 Empty Bottle to do it.
scripts.translation:
[弗魯茨]
很抱歉，您的材料不足，無法制作蘋果汁。
製作1瓶蘋果汁需要3個蘋果和1個空瓶。

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
Thank you,
please wait
just a moment.
scripts.translation:
[弗魯茨]
謝謝，請稍等片刻。

scripts.text:
^3355FF*Grind grind*
*Grind grind*
*Clang...!*^000000

[Fruitz]
There you go~
I hope you enjoy!
Please feel free to
stop by for your Apple
and Apple Juice needs
at anytime, adventurer~
scripts.translation:
[弗魯茨]
給您~
希望您喜歡！
冒險者，需要蘋果或蘋果汁時，隨時來找我~

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
Thanks for stopping
by my shop. Farewell!
Come by anytime when
you feel like having an
Apple to snack on~
scripts.translation:
[弗魯茨]
感謝光臨我的小店，再見！
想吃蘋果時，隨時歡迎再來哦~

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
I used to be a wandering
vagabond when, one day,
I took a nap and something
struck my head and awoke
me from my restful slumber.
scripts.translation:
[弗魯茨]
我以前是個流浪漢。
有一天，我正在打盹，忽然被什麼東西砸中了腦袋，從美夢裡驚醒了。

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
It turns out that I was
sleeping beneath an apple
tree and that an apple fell
and hit me on the head.
I was dying of hunger and
was about to eat that Apple...
scripts.translation:
[弗魯茨]
原來我睡在一棵蘋果樹下，一顆蘋果掉下來，砸中了我的腦袋。
我當時餓得要命，正準備吃掉那顆蘋果...

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
But suddenly, Kain, my old
friend from the mining days,
asked me to help him around
on the Airship. So I did, and
it was there where I found some
people playing the Dice game.
scripts.translation:
[弗魯茨]
可就在這時，我以前在礦山認識的老朋友凱恩，邀我去飛空艇上幫忙。
於是我就去了，還看到有人在那裡玩骰子游戲。

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
I was bored and curious
and ended up wagering that
single Apple in a game of
dice. But for some reason,
I had this incredible lucky
streak. One apple became two...
scripts.translation:
[弗魯茨]
我又無聊又好奇，就拿那唯一的蘋果下注，玩了一把骰子。
沒想到運氣好得驚人，一路贏了下去。
一個蘋果變成了兩個...

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
Two became four and
before I knew it, I had
cornered the Apple market!
I won so many Apples, I just
started my own business here
on the Airship. Weird, huh?
scripts.translation:
[弗魯茨]
兩個變成四個，不知不覺間，我竟然壟斷了蘋果市場！
贏來的蘋果太多，我索性就在飛空艇上開了家店。
奇怪吧？

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
So Apples are good
for you. They were
certainly very good
to me. Hahahahaah~!
scripts.translation:
[弗魯茨]
所以說，蘋果是個好東西。
反正它可是幫了我大忙。
哈哈哈哈哈~！

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
Thank you for
using my shop.
Farewell~
scripts.translation:
[弗魯茨]
感謝您光顧我的小店。
再見~

the number of Apples you
wish to purchase again.
scripts.translation:
[梅爾茨]
您輸入的數字超過了最大值500。
請重新輸入您想購買的蘋果數量。

scripts.text:
[Meltz]
A total of ^FF0000{0}^000000 Apples
will cost you ^FF0000{1}^000000 zeny.
Would you like to continue?
scripts.translation:
[梅爾茨]
購買^FF0000{0}^000000個蘋果，共需^FF0000{1}^000000 Zeny。
您要繼續購買嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Meltz]
Thanks for stopping
by my shop. Farewell!
Come by anytime when
you feel like having an
Apple to snack on~
scripts.translation:
[梅爾茨]
感謝光臨我的小店，再見！
想吃蘋果時，隨時歡迎再來哦~

scripts.text:
[Meltz]
I'm sorry, you don't have
enough money with you.
Please check your funds or
purchase less Apples.
scripts.translation:
[梅爾茨]
很抱歉，您的Zeny不足。
請檢查您持有的Zeny，或減少購買數量。

scripts.text:
[Meltz]
Hmm, I don't think you've
got enough room to carry
this many Apples. You might
want to free up your inventory
space.
scripts.translation:
[梅爾茨]
嗯，您的背包空間不夠，裝不下這麼多蘋果。
請先騰出一些空間。

scripts.text:
[Meltz]
Thanks for stopping by
my shop. I hope you enjoy
the flavor of these Apples~!
scripts.translation:
[梅爾茨]
感謝您光顧我的小店。
希望您喜歡這些蘋果的味道~！

scripts.text:
[Meltz]
Okay, I'll need
^FF00003 Apples and 1 Empty Bottle^000000
to make 1 Apple Juice for you.
Would you like to proceed?
scripts.translation:
[梅爾茨]
好的，製作1瓶蘋果汁需要^FF00003個蘋果和1個空瓶^000000。
您要繼續嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Meltz]
I'm sorry, but you don't
have enough materials to
create a bottle of Apple Juice.
Remember, I need 3 Apples
and 1 Empty Bottle to do it.
scripts.translation:
[梅爾茨]
很抱歉，您的材料不足，無法制作蘋果汁。
製作1瓶蘋果汁需要3個蘋果和1個空瓶。

scripts.text:
[Meltz]
Thank you, please wait.
scripts.translation:
[梅爾茨]
謝謝，請稍等。

scripts.text:
^3355FF*Grind* *Grind*
*Grind* *Grind*
*Clang...!*^000000

[Meltz]
There you go~
Please come again.
scripts.translation:
[梅爾茨]
給您~
歡迎再次光臨。

scripts.text:
[Meltz]
Thanks for stopping
by my shop. Farewell!
Come by anytime when
you feel like having an
Apple to snack on~
scripts.translation:
[梅爾茨]
感謝光臨我的小店，再見！
想吃蘋果時，隨時歡迎再來哦~

scripts.text:
[Meltz]
Thanks for stopping
by my shop. Farewell!
Come by anytime when
you feel like having an
Apple to snack on~
scripts.translation:
[梅爾茨]
感謝光臨我的小店，再見！
想吃蘋果時，隨時歡迎再來哦~

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
Longitude, 131 degrees east.
Latitude, 37 degrees north.
We're right on course, captain.
scripts.translation:
[飛行員]
東經131度。
北緯37度。
我們正沿著航線前進，船長。

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
Looks like a really
cloudy day. Always hard
to navigate when the skies
aren't clear. Guess we'll
need to amp the radar.
scripts.translation:
[飛行員]
今天雲層真厚。
天空不晴朗，導航就很費勁。
看來得增強雷達功率了。

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
The Captain is a good
man and I can't think of
a finer person to command
this ship. Still, he's pretty
tough, a real slave driver.
scripts.translation:
[飛行員]
船長是個好人，我想不出還有誰比他更適合指揮這艘船。
不過，他也真夠嚴厲的，簡直把我們當苦力使喚。

scripts.text:
[^ff0000Tarlock^000000]
^ff0000Hey...!^000000
^ff0000Less chit-chat^000000
^ff0000and more piloting!^000000

[Pilot]
R-right away, sir!
(See what I mean?)
scripts.translation:
[飛行員]
是...是，長官！
（這下你明白了吧？）

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
This uniform is
really dapper, but
it's way too thick to
wear around the Airship.
scripts.translation:
[飛行員]
這身制服是挺帥，可在飛空艇上穿，實在太厚了。

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
...
......
No one ever really
comes into this room.
And the captain IS a reindeer.
I could just strip to my boxers.
scripts.translation:
[飛行員]
...
......
反正也沒什麼人會進這間屋子。
而且船長還是隻馴鹿，我乾脆脫得只剩條內褲好了。

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
Oh...! Hello there!
E-e-enjoying your flight?!
scripts.translation:
[飛行員]
哦...！你好！
這...這趟飛行還愉快嗎？！

scripts.text:
[Dianne]
It's so weird!
I went to visit the
Airship Captain and
all I saw was this
weird reindeer. Oh!
Do you think that...
scripts.translation:
[黛安]
太奇怪了！
我去拜訪飛空艇船長，結果只看到一隻奇怪的馴鹿。
哦！你說會不會...

scripts.text:
[Mendel]
As I expected, the
in-flight meals are
three star quality at best.
*Harrrumph* I really should
have brought my chef so that
I could enjoy a real meal.
scripts.translation:
[門德爾]
果然不出我所料，機上餐食充其量只有三星水平。
*哼* 我真該把廚師帶來，才能吃上一頓像樣的飯。

scripts.text:
[Swordsman Shimizu]
Finally, after five
years of waiting...
I can have my revenge!
scripts.translation:
[劍士 清水]
等了五年，終於...
我終於可以報仇了！

scripts.text:
[Swordsman Shimizu]
I just...
Have to make sure that
I don't keep missing my
stop. But soon, very soon,
vengeance will be mine!
scripts.translation:
[劍士 清水]
我只要...
別再坐過站就行了。
很快，很快，我就能報仇雪恨！

scripts.text:
[Nils]
Welcome to the
^ff0000RO Typing Challenge^000000.
Would you like to play
a quick typing game?
scripts.translation:
[尼爾斯]
歡迎參加^ff0000RO打字挑戰^000000。
想來玩一局打字遊戲嗎？

scripts.text: Play ^ff0000RO Typing Challenge^000000
scripts.translation: 參加^ff0000RO打字挑戰^000000

scripts.text: Information
scripts.translation: 遊戲說明

scripts.text: View Top Records
scripts.translation: 檢視最高紀錄

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Nils]
Okay, we have
a new challenger!
Enter the following
text as quickly as you
can without making any
mistakes! Let's start~!
scripts.translation:
[尼爾斯]
好，新的挑戰者來了！
請用最快的速度輸入下面的文字，一個字也不能錯！
開始吧~！

scripts.text:
[Nils]
Your record is ^ff0000{0} seconds^000000 and
the total letters are {1}.
scripts.translation:
[尼爾斯]
你的用時為^ff0000{0}秒^000000，總字元數為{1}。

scripts.text:
[Nils]
Hmmm, this record isn't
humanly possible unless you
copy and paste the whole
sentence. Please play fairly
next time.
scripts.translation:
[尼爾斯]
嗯，除非把整句話複製貼上過來，否則不可能打得這麼快。
下次請遵守遊戲規則。

scripts.text:
[Nils]
The previous top record was
made by ^0000ff{0}^000000
with the total ^0000ff{1}^000000 letters.
However, ^ff0000{2}^000000,
you made the new top record
this time. Congratulations!
scripts.translation:
[尼爾斯]
之前的紀錄保持者是^0000ff{0}^000000，輸入的字元總數為^0000ff{1}^000000。
不過，^ff0000{2}^000000，你這次創下了新的最高紀錄。
恭喜你！

scripts.text:
[Nils]
^0000ff{0}^000000
is the current
record holder with
a letter total of ^0000ff{1}^000000
characters. Try to beat
that record next time~
scripts.translation:
[尼爾斯]
目前的紀錄保持者是^0000ff{0}^000000，輸入的字元總數為^0000ff{1}^000000。
下次試著打破這個紀錄吧~

scripts.text:
[Nils]
Oooh...
I'm sorry, but
you entered the
text incorrectly...
scripts.translation:
[尼爾斯]
噢...
很抱歉，你輸入的文字有誤...

scripts.text:
[Nils]
The ^ff0000RO Typing Challenge^000000
is a game where you enter
the given text as quickly as you
can. The name of the top player
is recorded for posterity. If you
want fame, here's your chance!
scripts.translation:
[尼爾斯]
^ff0000RO打字挑戰^000000就是比誰能更快地輸入指定的文字。
紀錄保持者的名字會被記錄下來。
想出名的話，機會來了！

scripts.text:
[Nils]
I'd just like to let
you know that you type
all the text that you see
in the single input line that
you're given. So don't press
the enter key, just click 'OK.'
scripts.translation:
[尼爾斯]
提醒一下，請把看到的所有文字都輸入同一個輸入框。
不要按回車鍵，輸入完後點擊“確定”就行。

scripts.text:
[Nils]
^0000ff{0}^000000
is the current
record holder with
a letter total of ^0000ff{1}^000000
characters. Try to beat
that record next time~
scripts.translation:
[尼爾斯]
目前的紀錄保持者是^0000ff{0}^000000，輸入的字元總數為^0000ff{1}^000000。
下次試著打破這個紀錄吧~

scripts.text:
[Nils]
Feel free to take on the
^ff0000RO Typing Challenge^000000
anytime. I'll be here~
scripts.translation:
[尼爾斯]
隨時歡迎參加^ff0000RO打字挑戰^000000。
我會在這裡等你~

scripts.text:
[Clarice]
Hi, I'm Clarice~
How would you like
to wager some Apples
in a friendly game of Dice?
scripts.translation:
[克拉麗絲]
嗨，我是克拉麗絲~
想用蘋果當賭注，來玩一局骰子嗎？

scripts.text: Play Dice Game
scripts.translation: 玩骰子游戲

scripts.text: Learn Dice Game Rules
scripts.translation: 瞭解骰子游戲規則

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm up for a game of
dice whenever you feel
like it. Just talk to me if
you ever get hit with the
sudden urge to gamble, kay?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
想玩骰子的話，隨時來找我。
哪天突然想賭一把，就來跟我說，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The rules for the Dice game
are pretty simple. First, you
place a bet by wagering Apples.
You can bet a maximum of 50
Apples at a time. To keep things
legal, I can only accept Apples.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
骰子游戲的規則很簡單，先用蘋果下注，每次最多押50個。
為了遵守規定，我只收蘋果。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
But hey, if all that zeny
is burning a hole in your
pocket, head over to Fruitz
and you can buy as many
Apples as you want, playah~
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不過，要是你口袋裡的Zeny多得燙手，就去找弗魯茨買蘋果吧。
想買多少都行，朋友~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Now, we begin with me
rolling two 6-sided dice.
When it's your turn, you'll
roll two 6-sided dice. After
that, both of us will have the
option of rolling a third die.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
先由我擲兩顆六面骰子，再輪到你擲兩顆。
之後，我們各自可以選擇要不要再擲第三顆。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Now here's the important
thing. If your total is higher
than 12, you'll bust, meaning
that you lose. Otherwise, the
person with the higher total
is the winner. Got it?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
接下來可要聽仔細了。
總點數超過12點就算爆點，直接輸掉這局。
否則，總點數高的一方獲勝。
明白了嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Now, you'll be the first
to decide whether or not
you'll roll the third die. Then,
depending on your result, I'll
roll my third die... Or maybe not.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
先由你決定要不要擲第三顆骰子。
然後我會根據你的結果，決定要不要也擲第三顆。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
When you win, you'll
receive twice as many
Apples as you wagered.
But if we happen to tie, you
get the Apples that you bet
returned to you. Fair, right?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你贏了，就能拿到下注數量兩倍的蘋果。
如果打平，就退還你下注的蘋果。
公平吧？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ooh, so you'll play with
me? Great! How many
Apples would you like to bet?
Remember, you can wager
up to 50 Apples. If you'd like
to cancel, please enter '0'.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦，你要和我玩？
太好了！想押多少個蘋果？
最多可以押50個，輸入“0”就取消。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Changed your mind?
I understand. Well then,
I hope we can play sometime.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
改變主意了？
沒關係，希望改天能一起玩。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You can't bet more than
50 Apples. Remember, we
need to keep these stakes
reasonable. Please enter
a value no greater than 50.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
最多隻能押50個蘋果，賭注可不能太大。
請輸入不超過50的數量。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So you'll be
betting ^FF0000{1}^000000 Apples.
Is that right?
Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Mm, made a mistake?
Alright, please enter the
number of Apples you
wish to place in this bet
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，輸錯了？
好，請重新輸入這局要押的蘋果數量。

scripts.text:
I'm sorry, but you
don't seem to have
enough Apples for this
bet... You can't gamble
if you can't play, you know.
scripts.translation:
很抱歉，你的蘋果好像不夠下注...
沒有籌碼，可玩不了這個遊戲啊。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Good!
Now we can start
this game! I'll roll first~
^3355FF*Rolling and rumbling*^000000
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好！這就開始吧！
我先擲~
^3355FF*骰子滾動碰撞的聲音*^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FF*Rolling and rumbling*^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF*骰子滾動碰撞的聲音*^000000

scripts.text: Cast Dice.
scripts.translation: 擲骰子

scripts.text: ^3355FF*Rolling and rumbling*^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF*骰子滾動碰撞的聲音*^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Currently my total is ^0000FF{1}^000000 and ^FF0000{2}^000000, your total is ^FF0000{3}^000000. We are making an even game. Would you like to cast dice again?

[{0}]
Currently my total is ^0000FF{1}^000000 and ^FF0000{2}^000000, your total is ^FF0000{3}^000000. ^FF0000{4}^000000, you are currently winning this game. Would you like to cast dice again?

[{0}]
Currently my total is ^0000FF{1}^000000 and ^FF0000{2}^000000, your total is ^FF0000{3}^000000. I am winning this game. Would you like to cast dice again?
Cast dice.
scripts.translation: 擲骰子

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text: ^3355FF*Rolling and rumbling*^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF*骰子滾動碰撞的聲音*^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
^FF0000{1}^000000, you got ^FF0000{2}^000000 and the total is now ^FF0000{3}^000000. You lost this game. I am sorry but please try again.

[{0}]
^FF0000{1}^000000, you got ^FF0000{2}^000000 and the total is now ^FF0000{3}^000000. Even though you casted dice again, still your total is smaller than mine. You lost the game. I am sorry and please try again.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
^FF0000{1}^000000，你擲出了^FF0000{2}^000000點，現在總共^FF0000{3}^000000點。
雖然多擲了一顆骰子，你的總點數還是比我低。
這局你輸了，真遺憾，下次再試試吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
^FF0000{1}^000000, you got ^FF0000{2}^000000 and the total is now ^FF0000{3}^000000. I don't want to take any risk, let's end this game in a draw. Let's play again some other time~

[{0}]
Alright.
Let me cast the dice again.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好的。
讓我再擲一次骰子。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
^FF0000{1}^000000, you got ^FF0000{2}^000000 and the total is now ^FF0000{3}^000000. Now it is my turn.

[{0}]
I see, you don't want to take risk of losing this game. Neither do I, let's end this game in a draw. Let's play again some other time~
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
明白了，你不想冒險輸掉這局。
我也不想，那就算平局吧。
改天再玩~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It couldn't hurt to try.
Well, I win this time.
I'm sorry, let's try play
again sometime.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
試試也無妨。
不過，這次是我贏了。
真遺憾，改天再來玩吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I see, you don't want to take risk of losing the game. Okay, let me cast dice again.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
明白了，你不想冒險輸掉這局。
好，那我再擲一顆骰子。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Alright.
Let me cast the dice again.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好的。
讓我再擲一次骰子。

scripts.text: ^3355FF*Rolling and rumbling*^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF*骰子滾動碰撞的聲音*^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I got ^0000FF{1}^000000 and the total is now ^0000FF{2}^000000. I lost this game since my total exceeded 12. Let me give you my apples. Congratulations, that was a great game.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我擲出了^0000FF{1}^000000點，現在總共^0000FF{2}^000000點。
總點數超過12點，這局我輸了。
給，這是你贏的蘋果。
恭喜，玩得真過癮！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I got ^0000FF{1}^000000 and the total is now ^0000FF{2}^000000. With total ^FF0000{3}^000000 you won this game, ^FF0000{4}^000000. Let me give you my apples. It was a great game and I hope we will play again some other time.

[{0}]
I got ^0000FF{1}^000000 and the total is now ^0000FF{2}^000000. With total ^FF0000{3}^000000 this game came out even, ^FF0000{4}^000000. Let me give you your apple back. It was a great game and I hope we will play again some other time.

[{0}]
I got ^0000FF{1}^000000 and the total is now ^0000FF{2}^000000. With total ^FF0000{3}^000000 you lost this game, ^FF0000{4}^000000. I am sorry but please try again.
